title: No-stub gate lacked executable proof

evidence.excerpt: text search accepted pass and ellipsis-only bodies

impact: release evidence could contradict active source
recommended_action: add AST-based release-readiness validation and CI enforcement

title: Malformed JavaScript manifest was silently ignored

evidence.excerpt: JSON and key errors ended in pass

impact: dependency topology could be incomplete without a failure signal
recommended_action: fail closed with repository-scoped validation errors

title: Required release handoff artifacts were absent

evidence.excerpt: manifest, final tree, Unknown register, regression guard, and traceability map absent

impact: operators could not verify inventory, residual risk, or fix provenance

title: Initial repository lacked complete governance and operator root surface

evidence.excerpt: architecture, governance, maintainership, support, release, development, threat, dependency, license, notice, and initial-commit authorities were incomplete or absent

impact: the implementation could run but could not be governed, released, supported, or handed off as a durable repository baseline
recommended_action: add the complete source-aligned root authority surface

title: Highest-risk architecture decisions lacked durable ADRs

evidence.excerpt: no accepted ADR set existed for packet boundaries, evidence, determinism, effects, orchestration, storage, or publication ownership

impact: future changes could silently reverse core v5 decisions without an explicit supersession process
recommended_action: add and index 20 accepted validation-backed ADRs

title: Canonical build source was not preserved as a standalone implementation authority

evidence.excerpt: full source-aligned v5 contract was added with source repository, commit, and blob lineage

impact: implementation intent could drift away from the design that produced the repository
recommended_action: retain BUILD_SPECIFICATION.md as the full initial repository build authority
